description: Use when you need every published snapshot for one game, oldest first. Pass gameId. Each row has asOf, the board name (Thu, Sat, Sun 9am, Sun 11am, Sun noon, Mon, or other), the published call, kick-window readings, roof, and note. A report-card grade is appended when that game has one. Returns those rows. flips lists each published call that left one call and landed on another, with gameId, from, to, and at. since is thursday when the latest call differs from the Thursday board, and prior when a snapshot differs from the previous snapshot. When the previous snapshot is the Thursday board and the calls and time match, since is thursday. Calls and readings are copied from published boards.
name: get_call_history
title: Call history
